messages:
lauren: FYI we discovered a signing mismatch during the runtime base-image rebuild. Need a quick sync on KMS rotation + rollback plan. :warning:
mark: What mismatch are you seeing?
lauren: Staging images signed with the new KMS key, but some deployers still verify only against the old public key; cosign verify is failing sporadically.
mark: That sounds like verifier principals weren't propagated to all deployer pools. Who owns the deployer SA mapping?
hana: I own that. I didn't push the new verifier principal to the deploy clusters yet 345. Doing it now.
ops-bot: Build 2026-04-12T14:03:02Z: cosign: verification failed: remote signature not found
lauren: Mitigation: pause prod rollouts, revert the pipeline to last-known-good image metadata, and switch the signer alias back to the old key until verifier propagation is confirmed.
mark: How long to revert the pipeline?
hana: ~8-10 minutes to flip the alias and redeploy the pipeline config. I'll add a short-lived feature flag to the CI that forces use of the `img-signing-active` alias.
lauren: Good. Also we need a rollback playbook note: who can flip aliases and who must approve? Two-person approval required for prod signer changes.
mark: Agreed. I'll file the terraform PR to add an immutable alias resource and the IAM binding updates.
sec: Add monitoring: alert on "cosign verify" failures > 3 in 30m across prod clusters; page oncall. Also update audit sink to include KMS AdminActivity entries so key policy changes are visible in sec-logs.
hana: Pushed verifier principal to staging and one canary cluster; re-running verification checks.
ops-bot: verify-step: success (staging). Both old and new public keys verify the canary images.
lauren: Action items:
- hana: propagate verifier principal to all deploy clusters + confirm cosign verify (ETA 2h)
- mark: open terraform PR to add key alias + IAM binding + preflight checks (PR link when ready)
- sec: create alert + update sink filter to include cloudkms admin events
- lauren: coordinate 48h validation window and then schedule safe rotation if no regressions

mark: I'll also add a CI preflight that runs `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and fails early if signer/verifier bindings are missing in envs.
hana: Done in staging, will iterate for prod. Re-running pipeline now.
ops-bot: pipeline: canary sign + verify: success.
lauren: OK. schedule final rotation 48h after prod verification, keep old key active for 14 days as a fallback, then revoke. Create infra-change + postmortem note after the window.
mark: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/1456 (rbac/kms: add alias + bindings + preflight)
sec: Alert created and linked to runbook; sink filter updated pending infra merge.
lauren: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if anything unusual appears in the next 48h. If verification fails during that time, open #incident-kms-sign and tag oncall.
